spans.s:
गव गव = गो, a cow, cattle; used at the
beginning of a compound before a word beginning
with a vowel, see below; also at the end of a com-
pound (e. g. पञ्च-गवम्, five cows); (अस्), m. a
ray of the sun.
—गव-राज, अस्, m. a bull.
—गवा-
कृति (˚व-आक्˚), इस्, इस्, इ, cow-shaped.
—गवाक्ष
(˚व-अक्˚), अस्, m. an air-hole, a loop-hole, a round
window, a ‘bull's eye,’ &c.; the mesh of a shirt of
mail; N. of a warrior; N. of a monkey-chief
attached to Rāma, a son of Vaivasvata, the leader of
the Go-lāṅgūlas; N. of a sea (n. in this sense?); (ई),
f. a sort of cucumber, Cucumis Maderaspatanus or
Coloquintida; the plant Trophis Aspera (शाखोट);
the plant Clitoria Ternatea.
—गवाक्षक, अस्, m.
an air-hole, a loop-hole, a round window, a bull's
eye.
—गवाक्ष-जाल, अम्, n. a lattice, a window of
trellice-work.
—गवाक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished
with windows, forming a lattice.
—गवाग्र = गो-
अग्र = गो ऽग्र, q. v.
—गवादन (˚व-अद्˚), अम्,
n. pasture or meadow grass; (ई), f. pasture or meadow
grass, a hay-rack, a manger, a trough for holding
grass &c. for feeding cattle; a species of cucumber,
Cucumis Maderaspatanus, or (according to some)
Cucumis Coloquintida; the plant Clitoria Ternatea.
—गवामृत (˚व-अम्˚), अम्, n. the beverage of
immortality or nectar consisting of rays of light.
—गवार्थम् or गवार्थे (˚व-अर्˚), ind. for the
sake of a cow.
—गवार्ह (˚व-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, of
the value of a cow.
—गवाविक (˚व-अव्˚), अम्, n.
cattle and sheep.
—गवाशन (˚व-अश्˚), अस्, m. =
गो-भक्षक, commonly मुचि, i. e. a worker in
leather, a shoe-maker; an outcast.
—गवाशिर (˚व-
आश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. mixed with milk, as Soma.
—गवाश्व (˚व-अश्˚), अम्, n. cattle and horses; [cf.
गो-अश्व and गोऽश्व.]
—गवाह्निक (˚व-आह्˚), अम्,
n. the daily measure of food given to a cow.
—गवेन्द्र (˚व-इन्˚), अस्, m. an owner of kine.
—गवेश or गवेश्वर (˚व-ईश्˚), अस्, m. an owner
of kine.
—गवैडक (˚व-एड्˚), अम् n. kine and
sheep.
—गवोद्घ (˚व-उद्˚), अस्, m. an excellent
cow.
गवची, f. a Coloquintida, = गवाक्षी.

गवाची, f. (fr. गो and rt. अञ्च्), a kind of fish,
commonly पाङ्कालमाच, Ophidium Punctatum or
Macrognathus Pankalus.

गवय, अस्, m. a species of ox, the Gayal, Bos
Gavæus, erroneously classed by Hindū writers as a
species of deer; a monkey-chief attached to Rāma,
the son of Vaivasvata; (ई), f. the female Gayal.

गवल, अस्, m. the wild buffalo; (अम्), n.
buffalo's horn.

गवाम्-अय, अस्, m. or गवाम्-अयन, अम्, n.
‘going of cows,’ N. of a solemn ceremony; [cf. गो.]

गवाम्-पति, इस्, m. a guardian of cows, a cow-
herd; the chief of cattle, a bull; the lord of rays, an
epithet of the sun; also of Agni; N. of a Buddhist
mendicant.

गवालूक, अस्, m. the Gayal, Bos Gavæus; [cf.
गवय.]

गवि-जात, अस्, m., N. of a Muni.
—गवि-पुत्र,
अस्, m. an epithet of Vaiśravaṇa.
—गवि-ष्ठिर, अस्,
[]
m., N. of a Ṛṣi of Atri's family; [cf. गाविष्ठिर
and गाविष्ठिरायण.]
गविनी, f. a herd of cows.

गव्-इष्, ट्, ट्, ट्, or गव्-इष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved.
wishing for cows, desirous in general, eager, fervent.
—गव्-इष्टि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. wishing for cows; desir-
ing fervently, eager, ardent; (इस्), f. desire, eagerness,
ardour, fervour; desire for fighting, ardour of battle,
battle.
—गव्-ईश or गव्-ईश्वर, अस्, m. an owner
of kine.

गविष्ठ, अस्, m. the sun (either a superl. fr. गो,
‘a ray,’ or fr. गवि + स्थ, ‘standing in water’); N.
of a Dānava.

गवेष (either fr. गव + इष्, or गो + एष्), nom.
cl. 1. A. or 10. P. गवेषते or गवेषयति, -यि-
तुम्, to desire ardently or fervently, to strive after;
to seek, hunt after, search or inquire for.
—गवे-
षण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. desiring ardently or fervently;
desirous of combat; (अस्), m., N. of a Vṛṣṇi; (आ,
अम्), f. n. seeking after, searching for, inquiry,
philosophical research.
—गवेषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be desired or sought for.
—गवेषित, अस्, आ, अम्,
eagerly desired, sought, inquired for.
—गवेषिन्, ई,
इणी, इ, seeking; (ई), m., N. of a son of Citraka and
brother of Pṛthu.
गवेष्ठिन्, ई, m., N. of a Dānava.

1. गव्य, nom. P., Ved. गव्यति, to desire cattle
or cows; especially in the part. गव्यत्, अन्, अन्ती,
अत्, wishing for or desirous of cattle or cows; ardently
or fervently desiring, fervent; desirous of battle.

2. गव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, consisting of cattle or cows,
consisting of milk; coming from, of, or belonging
to a cow, as milk, curds, &c. (e. g. पञ्च-गव्य,
अम्, n. five things coming from a cow, — milk,
cheese, butter, urine, and dung); proper or fit for
cattle; sacred to the cow, worshipping the cow;
(अस्), m., N. of a people in the north of Madhya-
deśa; (अम्), n. cattle, a herd of cows; pasture land;
the milk of a cow; a bow-string; a colouring sub-
stance, a yellow pigment or dye; (अस्, आ, अम्,
differing from the preceding only by its accent),
belonging to cattle, consisting of cattle or cows,
coming from cattle or cows; (आ), f. a multitude or
herd of cows; a measure equal to 1 Gavyūti or
2 Krośas; a bow-string; a colouring substance, a
yellow pigment or dye; [cf. गो-रोचना.]
—गव्य-
दृढ, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a colouring
substance, a yellow pigment or dye; [cf. the pre-
ceding.]

गव्या, f., Ved. desire for or delight in cows;
desire, fervency; desire for what comes from a cow,
i. e. for milk; desire of battle (generally used in the
Ved. inst. गव्या).

गव्यय, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. belonging to or coming
from cattle.
गव्ययु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desirous of cattle.

गव्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. delighting in cattle or
cows; desiring cows or milk; fervent; desirous of
battle.

गव्यूत, अम्, n. a measure of length equal to
2000 Daṇḍas or 1 Krośa, or to 4000 Daṇḍas or
2 Krośas; [cf. the following.]

गव्यूति, इस्, f. (fr. गो and यूति ? or गो and ऊति?),
Ved. a pasture, a piece of pasture land, a district, place
of residence; a measure of length equal to 4000
Daṇḍas or 2 Krośas.

गवल्गण गवल्गण, अस्, m., N. of a man,
the father of Sañjaya; (also read गवल्गाण); [cf.
गावल्गणि.]

गवाषिका गवाषिका, f. the insect called
Lākṣā, and the red dye prepared from it; [cf. गरा-
धिका.]

गवीधुक गवीधुक, अस्, आ, m. f., Ved. the
grass Coix Barbata; [cf. गवेधुक.]

गवेडु गवेडु, उस्, m. a cloud; (उस्), f. or
गवेडुका, f. a kind of grass, Coix Barbata; [cf. the
following.]
गवेधु गवेधु, उस्, f. the grass Coix Barbata.

गवेधुक, अस्, m. a kind of serpent; (आ), f. a
species of grass, Coix Barbata; according to some
authorities also Hedysarum Lagopodioides [cf. गवे-
शका]; (अम्), n. red chalk; [cf. गवीधुक, गवेडु,
गवेरुक.]

गवेरुक गवेरुक, अम्, n. red chalk; [cf.
गवेधुक, n.]

गवेशका गवेशका, f. the plant Hedysarum
Lagopodioides.

गावल्गणि गावल्गणि, इस्, m. (fr. गवल्गण),
a patronymic of Sañjaya.

गाविष्ठिर गाविष्ठिर and गाविष्ठिरायण,
two patronymics from Gavi-ṣṭhira.

गवाशिर; the base should rather be गवाशिर्,
Nom. case masc. fem. गवाशीर्.
